messages:
alina: Quick follow-up from postmortem for incident 3120043210. Observed pattern: client reconnect spikes + tight keepalive causing KV cache pressure -> truncated/partial stream chunks. We need 3 parallel fixes with owners: runtime heartbeat, client backoff, and routing fallbacks.
samir: Agreed. Prefer soft mitigations over rollback if possible.
devon: I'll handle runtime heartbeat changes. Plan: add jitter, set idle keepalive to 15s, max missed = 3. Canary to staging and measure partial_chunk_rate. ETA Wed EOD.
marco: I'll own client reconnect/backoff and SDK updates. Proposed client policy: exponential backoff with capped jitter, max_attempts=6, and client-side circuit-breaker when partial_rate > 5% over 60s. Will open PR Tue AM. Also add graceful-downgrade header so server can request non-stream path.
sre_lead: Ops will implement surge detection thresholds and soft-fallback routing rules (route to small-model / non-stream endpoint). Need alert + runbook. @ops-bot create ticket.
ops-bot: INF-5321 created: "Streaming surge detection + soft-fallback runbook" https://redwood/INF-5321
oncall-bot: Scheduled canary: heartbeat config deploy to staging at 3120043300 UTC.
devon: Runtime snippet I'll apply: keepalive_interval=15s; keepalive_jitter=0.2; max_missed=3; prefetch_cache_ttl=30s. Adding metric missed_heartbeats_per_session.
marco: SDK will be backward compatible; header opt-in. Adding integration tests for header negotiation and fallback. Adding infra-perf load scenario to reproduce many short reconnect streams.
samir: Can infra-perf include that test in gating so we don't regress?
marco: Yes, I'll link the scenario in my PR.
sre_lead: @alina add new metrics to dashboard: partial_response_rate, stream_latency_p90, and composite alert (partials + queue growth). Escalation: if partial_response_rate > 3% for 5m escalate to SRE lead.
alina: Done: updated postmortem doc and checklist (https://redwood/incident/3120043210/postmortem), created weekly 30-min sync invites. Owners: Devon (heartbeat Wed EOD), Marco (client backoff Tue AM), Ops (runbook Fri EOD). Observation window 4 weeks; rollback gate if partials > 3% sustained.
samir: Next sync Tue 09:30 PT. Please attach PR links & test outputs to INF-5321 beforehand.
alina: Closing note: priority #1 is observability (we lack partial-response traces). Add tracing to stream chunks so we can correlate aborted streams to client events. Thanks everyone. :wave:
